messages:
Priya (CS): FYI EmberHealth telemetry shows a sharp fall in activity starting 2026-03-18 — tokens down ~70%, active seats reduced. Procurement reached out about an RFP. Let's triage as renewal risk.

Noah (AM): Thanks. New ML lead onboarded last week, but no reply to intro yet (Olivia left). Procurement contact is Ben. I'll ping procurement and draft a trial offer.

Ava (CSM): Marcus (champion) messaged me that their infra team paused calls after seeing intermittent 5xx & high latency. Hes worried about reliability in prod.

Miguel (SE): Checked logs: sudden increase in prefix cache misses + proxy rejects around 2026-03-18T14:03Z. Sample error: 
```
ERROR ingest.service - webhook timeout 504 id=ctx-d4a1 upstream reset
WARN batcher - dropped batch size=512 reason=proxy_reject
```
No rolling deploys on our side. Hypothesis: customer proxy tightened max payload or concurrent connections.

enablement-bot: ALERT EmberHealth: usage drop >50% 7d. Recommended plays: quick repro, dedicated trial, champion enablement pack.

Priya (CS): Proposed playbook: 1) Immediate tech sync with Ember infra + Miguel to reproduce (tomorrow 10am PT). 2) Offer 30-day Dedicated pool to show isolation and steady throughput. 3) QBR invite to new ML lead + procurement to re-establish ROI. Who owns outreach? :thinking_face:

Noah (AM): Ill handle procurement + trial terms today and include legal-friendly SLO language. Will CC Priya.

Miguel (SE): Confirmed for 10am PT. I'll build a tiny repro curl and a 5-step runbook to validate proxy limits quickly:
```
curl -vv -X POST https://ingest.redwood.example/v1/prefix -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"batch":[{"input":"x"}],"meta":{"size":1}}'
```
If that fails, increase granularity and watch proxy response headers.

Ava (CSM): I'll send Marcus a one-pager enablement checklist + quickstart links and try to re-engage the champion before the sync.

Priya (CS): Owners recap: Miguel (SE) - repro + runbook (tomorrow); Noah (AM) - procurement outreach & trial terms (today); Ava (CSM) - champion touch + enablement doc (today); Priya - update renewal risk score + draft communication. Please post sync notes here. :thumbsup:
